101231.title: Rear wheel assembly relationships
guidance: Inspect 1 EA LL Shell (Product Number SH-4562) and 1 EA LL Spindle/Axle (Product Number SD-2342); fit their intended interfaces to prepare 1 EA LL Hub (Product Number HU-6280) only if the supplied assembly details are clear. Hold if bearing or retention details are missing.
Inspect 1 EA LL Mountain Rim (Product Number RM-M464), 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283), and 36 EA LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127) for visible damage and compatibility with the hub.

Using an assumed wheel-building stand and spoke wrench, connect the spokes between the hub and rim with the nipples, following the applicable lacing information. The schematic relationships are shown in 101231; hold if the pattern is not available.

Fit 1 EA Mountain Tire Tube (Product Number TT-M928) inside 1 EA LL Mountain Tire (Product Number TI-M267) and mount them on the rim using assumed tire levers as needed. Check that the tube is not visibly pinched and inflate according to the applicable tire instructions.
Attach 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) using their supplied attachment method. Check their security, tire seating, and free wheel rotation; hold any visibly damaged or uncertain assembly.
